citation: Mallory CS, Hardcastle K, Bant JS, Giocomo LM (2018). Grid scale drives the scale and long-term stability of place maps. Nat Neurosci 21:270-282
strain: iWT littermates of floxed HCN1 mice (hybrid 50:50 C57BL/6J:129SVEV), AAV-DJ CMV cre-GFP in MEC; a separate cohort from mallory2018_1
level_definition: Tetrodes at -1.8 mm AP, 1.8 mm ML, 0.6 to 0.8 mm below the dura at implant (Online Methods); "dorsal hippocampus" (text)
environment_size: Linear track 100 x 7 cm, 23 cm above the floor, 31 cm black walls, placed in the open-field arena; analysis restricted to the central 70 cm
familiarity: trained 2 to 3 weeks until running back and forth with little hesitation; 15 to 30 min sessions
field_rule: 2.5 cm bins; a field's peak bin >= 1 Hz and > 20% of the cell's peak, extended in both directions while the rate stays above 20% of the field's peak; size = distance between the two boundaries; only fields whose boundaries fell within the central 70 cm; runs below 3 cm/s omitted; left and right runs separate; place cells first identified in the open field
fields_per_cell: about 1.4 (derived, 42 fields / 30 cells, counting left and right runs separately)
location: Supplementary Fig. 11a legend (ESM); rule in Online Methods, "Linear track recordings and analyses of phase precession" (PDF p. 16)
quote_or_reading: "Field size on the linear track was larger in iCre-KO mice (mean ± SD; iWT = 22.98 ± 11.56, iCre-KO = 30.39 ± 14.92, two-tailed WRS Z = -2.26, p = 0.023; n = 42 fields from 30 cells from 3 iWT mice, 38 fields from 28 cells from 4 iCre-KO mice)" (Supplementary Fig. 11a). Online Methods: "The linear track, constructed of black-painted wood, was 100 × 7 cm (L × W)"; "Linear track analyses were restricted to fields whose boundaries fell within the central 70 cm of the track"
notes: The 70 cm window caps the longest fields. The same legend gives a population width: the PV cross-correlation (unsmoothed 2.5 cm bins) fell to r = 0.2 at 28.8 ± 8.1 cm from the diagonal in iWT (30 place cells) against 34.2 ± 8.5 cm in iCre-KO; this is a kernel at r = 0.2, not r = 0.5. The ESM text was read from the earlier sweep's file (tmp/sweep_mec/dl/mallory2018_esm/esm1.txt); the Online Methods from papers/pft2/s41593-017-0055-3.pdf. Same-cohort grid spacing not measured.
